notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1787). Words follow the Schirmer vocal score's spelling, punctuation and syllables, as sung; lines are repeated as the score repeats them, part by part. Where the print adds notes for its English text, the words follow the Italian. IPA, word meanings and translations were drafted for this app (S63), and the IPA was checked against Castel. IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two or three words on one note in the score: questo‿è‿il, sempre‿ugual, vita‿è) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ. Translation literal, for meaning.
